messages:
elena_csm: Somnex weekly health check (focus: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-stream). Short summary: overall calls +10% after their new chat UI, streaming p99 on /assist with redwood-70b-edge spiked; non-stream less impacted. Table: 

elena_csm: ```
Route | Model | Mode | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
/assist | redwood-70b-edge | streaming | 390 | 760
/assist | redwood-70b-edge | non-stream | 240 | 460
/notes | opt-6.7 | streaming | 160 | 310
/notes | opt-6.7 | non-stream | 130 | 240
/embed | embedding-pro | n/a | 95 | 180
```

drew_cs_ops: Not great UX for customers. Did Somnex change session length or start sending more context?

elena_csm: They increased client-side context retention from 3 to 8 turns on 2026-04-10 and did a 50% rollout yesterday. That aligns with the spike timeframe.

omar_infra: Infra observations: KV cache hit rate for redwood-70b-edge streaming dropped from ~71% -> 44% at 2026-04-10T15:20Z. Two older stream hosts showed increased OOM restarts and swap.

sasha_sre: Error rate steady at 0.4%. Streaming queue latency spiked, which explains p99. No pager yet but visible customer impact. I've added a short watch: streaming p99 > 700ms -> notify.

brian_runtime: Likely root cause: longer prefixes keep KV live and increase working set; recent kernel rollout (kopt-edge-v4) increased memory pressure for streaming. Short-term: migrate Somnex streaming to larger-memory pool and pin away from kopt-edge-v4. Medium-term: test a memory-optimized kernel or 5% quantized streaming canary.

elena_csm: Action items: 1) omar_infra - migrate flows to somnex-hot pool and post KV hit after 30m (ETA 30m). 2) brian_runtime - schedule 5% quantized streaming canary tomorrow and include quality checks (ETA 48h). 3) drew_cs_ops - prepare customer note framing work and ETA.

omar_infra: Started migration. Command used: ```bash
infractl migrate-flows --customer somnex --route /assist --mode streaming --to-pool somnex-hot --wait 20m
```
deploy-bot: migration-op: started (id: mig-2078).

omar_infra: 30m update: KV hit rate recovered to ~69% on hot pool. Early latency change: p95 streaming 390 -> 330ms, p99 760 -> 540ms.

brian_runtime: Good. I'll set up a 5% canary (quantized variant q-redwood-70b-edge) for streaming to run against Somnex tomorrow 09:00Z (canary-id: qcan-307). Will run eval for quality drift and post results.

sasha_sre: Watch rule fired briefly during migration but cleared. I've left the alert active and added a dashboard panel breaking p95/p99 by route+mode for Somnex.

drew_cs_ops: Drafted the customer note: concise explanation + actions taken + expected timeline (canary results in 48h). Will share for review before send.

elena_csm: Renewal impact: current health green but tail visible. Risk — low-medium while mitigation progresses; escalate if p99 > 700ms persists for two business days.

omar_infra: No further OOMs after migration. Monitoring KV and worker memory.

brian_runtime: Canary scheduled. Will post p95/p99 + quality diff after 2h of stable traffic. If p99 drops >20% with no quality regression, propose increasing canary to 25%.

elena_csm: Thanks team. Follow-ups: omar (kv hit + stability), brian (canary numbers), drew (customer note). Will reconvene next weekday if tail persists. :calendar:
